name: Oroszló (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Oroszló (a blue shield with a white horse between yellow trees on a green mound) above a yellow scroll inscribed OROSZLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
